messages:
Sara (devex): Quick heads-up — platform team is experimenting with more granular quota buckets per-route. I'm opening a thread to discuss how we stitch telemetry and what SDK changes we need.

Josh (eng-platform): What's the concrete header plan? We need something that won't break existing Python/TS/Go clients.

Maria (eng): Proposal: add two optional pass-through headers — `X-Redwood-Route` and `X-Redwood-Quota-Bucket`. SDKs should preserve and forward them; console uses `X-Redwood-Route` to surface per-route budget in Dash. Example: `X-Redwood-Route: feature/chat-completions`

Ben (telemetry): We also want a deterministic stitch key for sampling/rollups. Can we include `X-Redwood-Trace-Tag` (opaque string) so backend and client traces can correlate? :thinking:

Sara (devex): Rollout UX idea: make SDK support opt-in behind a flag `enableRouteTags` initially false. We can enable via canary and monitor console metrics before flipping default.

Josh (eng-platform): Important note: Python SDK currently normalizes and drops unknown `X-` headers in proxy flow. That would silently lose tags. Suggest we add explicit middleware that preserves `X-Redwood-*` headers.

Maria (eng): Minimal middleware sketch: 
```python
# client middleware (pseudo)
def forward_redwood_headers(request, response):
    for k, v in request.headers.items():
        if k.lower().startswith('x-redwood-'):
            response.headers[k] = v
```
Add unit tests to ensure round-trip.

Ben (telemetry): If SDKs can't add header for some customers, console should fallback to stitching by `session_id + prompt_hash`, but headers will be far more reliable for quota attribution. Also propose we standardize a sampling id format (base64 12-char).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: staging rollout at 11:30 PT. Watchlist: @josh_eng_platform, @ben_telemetry.

Sara (devex): Action items: 1) eng-platform add header pass-through middleware (owner: @josh_eng_platform), 2) SDK teams add opt-in flag + tests + changelog (owner: @sara_devex), 3) telemetry define sampling id format + stitching logic (owner: @ben_telemetry). Sync Wed 10am. :calendar:

Josh (eng-platform): Agreed. I'll open the PR for the middleware and include a compatibility layer that maps legacy `X-Route` -> `X-Redwood-Route` to avoid breaking older clients. Will add integration test against proxy.

Maria (eng): One more compatibility note: for on-prem/private deploys some infra strips headers — we should document that in the Private deployment guide and provide a fallback config for the nginx proxy: `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Route $http_x_route;`

Ben (telemetry): I'll draft the telemetry spec and sampling ID examples in the console repo and link here.

Sara (devex): Sounds good — I'll coordinate SDK release notes and an opt-in migration guide. :pray:
